entries.zh: 踩跷（高跷）行走；踏桥板／踏橇而过
entries.en: to walk on stilts (andar en zancos); to tread a bridge or stepping-stones
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注[疑:橋/橇]两读，西语 cancos 疑为 zancos（高跷）之变体，官话对音 tā mon 与汉字对合不紧，释义据推断给出

entries.zh: 轿；抬神像出游的神轿（轿座）
entries.en: palanquin, sedan chair; litter/platform for carrying a sacred image in procession
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:轎/簥]两读（均为轿之异写），四栏语义互证（andas de ymagen＝神轿）仍清晰，按规程列中等

entries.zh: 送轿（护送花轿／神轿）；赴轿
entries.en: to escort / send off the (bridal or sacred) sedan chair
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:僑/轎]，且官话对音 camg 与闽音 skǒg 不尽吻合，送／赴之义为推断

entries.zh: 亭仔（小亭）；安放神像出游用的小彩亭
entries.en: small pavilion, booth; canopy-litter for a sacred image

entries.zh: 龙亭（抬御诏或神像的龙纹亭轿）
entries.en: dragon pavilion; ceremonial dragon litter for imperial edicts or images

entries.zh: 添；添加
entries.en: to add

entries.zh: 添几粒（添上几颗、几件）
entries.en: to add a few (grains, pieces)

entries.zh: 应兵（临战征调、应敌补充之兵员）
entries.en: to answer the levy; to reinforce with soldiers in wartime
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:應]，西语栏 añadir soldados en la guerra 与之互证，征调义项为推断展开

entries.zh: 应接（接待、应酬；接应应答）
entries.en: to receive and attend to (guests); to respond, answer
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:應]；西语栏 gloss（añadir aumentar）与汉义贴合较松

entries.zh: 加；添上、增加
entries.en: to add, increase

entries.zh: 接（接上、接续；承接）
entries.en: to join, connect; to receive

entries.zh: 接长（接续加长）
entries.en: to lengthen by joining; to extend

entries.zh: 接柜尾（接续在末端／柜尾处）
entries.en: to join on at the tail end (of a chest or counter)
entries.notes: 西语栏 el axifique 难以确解，释义主要依汉／闽／官三栏互证

entries.zh: 接着（接住、接上；黏着相连）
entries.en: to connect, join on; to catch hold
entries.notes: 西语栏 hazer çavenells 难以确解，释义主要依汉／闽／官三栏互证

entries.zh: 架（架起、搭设；支挂）
entries.en: to put up, erect; to hang or support on a frame
entries.notes: 闽语栏声调号污损难辨（T99），按规程列低置信；字义本身仍清晰

entries.zh: 架添（在原有之上再加、添设）
entries.en: to add on top; to add besides
entries.notes: 闽语栏声调号污损难辨（T99），按规程列低置信

entries.zh: 贴（粘贴、张贴；补贴、垫补）
entries.en: to paste, stick on; to subsidize, make up (a sum)
entries.notes: 西语栏 los çetruca 难以确解，释义主要依汉／闽／官三栏互证

entries.zh: 贴到几（贴补到几多，问需添补多少）
entries.en: to top up / subsidize to how much; how far to add (when asking)

entries.zh: 贴一半（贴补一半、对半垫补）
entries.en: to subsidize half; to make up half the amount

entries.zh: 贴利钱（贴付利息、垫补利钱）
entries.en: to pay / cover interest; to subsidize the interest money
